2609.25130.title: Impact Is Not Invalidation: Ask About the Claim, Not the Diff
2609.25130.paper_summary: Memory systems for coding agents must decide, when a repository changes, which of their stored claims have become false. Content anchoring invalidates a claim whenever the artifact it came from changes, which fires constantly. Semantic-equivalence classification asks whether a diff preserves behavior, a question about the diff rather than about any stored claim. We show the second signal fails for a reason unrelated to model capability: asked whether a commit preserves behavior, five models spanning a 40x price range fire on 59-72% of real commits and reach precisions of only 0.291 to 0.329 against a 0.25 base rate. Asked instead whether one specific claim still holds, the same models on the same diffs reach 0.705 to 0.974. A control that hands the behavior-preservation judge the claim text, changing only the question, moves precision by 0.010 and 0.016; changing the question moves it by 0.49 and 0.65. We also compare against pytest-testmon, a deployed regression-test selector with coverage-derived dependency data: it reaches 0.868 recall at 0.415 precision, so near-complete knowledge of what a change can reach does not identify what it falsifies. Ground truth is execution, not annotation: a claim is a test function passing at commit t, and it has flipped if that same assertion text fails at t+1. Building this required an observation we did not find in prior work. On a CI-gated mainline a commit that leaves a pre-existing test failing cannot merge, so the naive construction has an empty positive class by design. We report 10,369 claims with 184 execution-verified flips mined from 23 Python libraries, splits held out by repository, a post-knowledge-cutoff split, a shuffled-diff null, a paraphrase control, and a leave-one-repository-out analysis over 17 repositories.
2609.25130.paper_summary_zh: 記憶系統對於編碼代理必須決定，當一個資料庫發生變化時，它們儲存的哪些聲明已經變得不正確。內容錨定在來源物件發生變化時使聲明失效，而這種情況不斷發生。語義等價分類則詢問差異是否保留了行為，這是一個關於差異而非任何儲存聲明的問題。我們顯示第二個信號失敗的原因與模型能力無關：當被問及一個提交是否保留行為時，五個模型跨越40倍的價格範圍，在59-72%的真實提交上觸發，並且在0.25的基準率下僅達到0.291到0.329的精確度。相反地，當被問及某一特定聲明是否仍然成立時，這些模型在相同的差異上達到0.705到0.974的精確度。一個控制實驗讓行為保留判斷者看到聲明文本，只改變問題，精確度變化為0.010和0.016；改變問題則使其變化為0.49和0.65。我們還與pytest-testmon進行比較，這是一個部署的回歸測試選擇器，擁有基於覆蓋率的依賴數據：它在0.415的精確度下達到0.868的召回率，因此對於變更能達到的幾乎完整的知識並不能識別它所否定的內容。真實情況是執行，而非註解：一個聲明是在提交t時通過的測試函數，如果在t+1時同樣的斷言文本失敗，則它已經翻轉。建立這一點需要一個我們在先前工作中未找到的觀察。在一個CI限制的主線上，任何使先前存在的測試失敗的提交都無法合併，因此這種天真的構造設計上有一個空的正類。我們報告了10,369個聲明，從23個Python庫中挖掘出184個經執行驗證的翻轉，這些庫按資料庫劃分，包含了一個知識截止後的分割、一個隨機差異的空白、一個改寫控制，以及對17個資料庫的逐一排除分析。
2609.25130.author: Atul Anand et.al.
